source_review.notes: Checked the current Java SE 26 Language Specification chapters on types, classes, initialization and creation; Python 3.14.7 data-model and class-definition references; ECMAScript 2026 class and ordinary-object semantics; the ECMA-335 standard record; and OMG UML 2.5.1. Checked publisher or primary records for Abadi/Cardelli, Bruce, Cook and Kay. The chapter attributes language-specific class, construction and membership rules to their governing specifications and does not promote one model to a universal definition.

notation_and_syntax.notes: The model deliberately covers nominal inherited membership; structural protocols, customized membership hooks and behavioral conformance use separate predicates.

evidence: Recomputed exact and inherited sets for Checking and Savings below Account after two fresh constructions.

evidence: Reviewed abstract and inaccessible classes, failing construction, factories, deserialization, cloning, cached and interned instances, pools, named instances and prototype-created objects.
Reviewed direct versus inherited membership, exact representation checks, structural protocols, defective subclasses and behavior that nominal declarations do not prove.
Reviewed Java defining class loaders, Python repeated definitions/reloads and customized ABC checks, and ECMAScript realms, prototype mutation and Symbol.hasInstance.

boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Clinical deployment, device authorization and regulatory acceptance remain human and institutional obligations outside automated review.

evidence: Checked direct class and inherited membership remain separate throughout definitions, examples and exercises.

Checked class-side mutable state is shared and never described as copied per instance.
Checked declared type, runtime class, runtime class object, domain category and implementation representation are not conflated.

Checked class membership never establishes provenance, authority, invariant preservation, certification or high-stakes fitness by itself.
invariant_checking.notes: Exact runtime rules remain language- and loading-context-specific.

evidence: Reviewed direct/inherited membership derivation and rejected the invalid ancestor-to-descendant converse.

Reviewed CertifiedInfusionPump as a counterexample to behavioral, safety or regulatory proof inferred from a nominal label.

proof_review.notes: The arguments prove consequences only inside the stated abstract model and assumptions.

evidence: Audited uses of class, type, instance, direct, inherited, exact, fresh, static, abstract, valid, safe, certified, authorized and proof.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter separates construction, direct and inherited classification, static typing, runtime class identity, instance-side ownership and class-side ownership while leaving dispatch, invariants, advanced constructor design, subtyping, language-specific object models, metaclasses and runtime layout to their dedicated modules.

practitioner_review.notes: Production guidance covers factories, abstract and restricted construction, shared mutable state, loaders, realms, reloads, serialization tags, plugin boundaries, compatibility, partial publication, concurrency, provenance, authority, and high-stakes fail-closed evidence.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with ten examples and five exercises progressing from fresh equal-state instances through exact/inherited and static/runtime distinctions, abstract classes, accidental sharing, dynamic class identity, prototype membership, loader identity, clinical misuse and representation choice.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
